title: What Terraform manages for ZIA users and authentication settings

prose.text: Terraform's coverage of authentication is narrow. {{provider-surface}}

The exempted-URL list resource has its own write-order and no-op-delete traps, recorded in [[zia.authentication.exemptions]]; user enrollment of authentication methods is a separate call that can fail silently, recorded in [[zia.terraform.multi-step-writes]]. The org settings object that Terraform does not manage is described in [[zia.authentication.settings]].

checks.do: Whether a drift report on authentication mode can come from Terraform, given that the provider does not manage the org authentication settings object.
Which of the two resources a configuration actually uses, zia_user_management or zia_auth_settings_urls.

provider-surface.statement: The ZIA Terraform provider registers a zia_user_management resource and data source and a zia_auth_settings_urls resource and data source. It registers no resource for the organization-wide authSettings object, so the tenant authentication mode (orgAuthType, samlEnabled and the rest) is not managed as code by the provider.
